text:
Situation: Aspirin and extended-release dipyridamole is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 472 units at 17.3 units per day (27 days on hand). Corvale General holds 722 units at 38.6 units per day (19 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds 49 units at 3.7 units per day (13 days on hand). The Par Health USA, LLC product label identifies PH HEALTH as the manufacturing plant.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows no entry for this product as of 2026-10-21. FDA status is listed as "To Be Discontinued since -" with no date provided.

Our position: Current inventory covers 13 to 27 days across sites. No active FDA shortage exists. Supply risk remains if the product is discontinued without replacement.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC (needs: buyer approval).
2. Buyer to evaluate and purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals of New York, LLC (needs: buyer approval).
3. Buyer to evaluate and purchase from AvKARE (needs: buyer approval).
4. Buyer to evaluate and purchase from Breckenridge Pharmaceutical, Inc. (needs: buyer approval).
5. Buyer to evaluate and purchase from Bryant Ranch Prepack (needs: buyer approval).
6. Buyer to confirm manufacturing plant details for each alternative supplier (needs: buyer approval).
7. Pharmacy director to review therapeutic alternatives with P&T committee if supply cannot be secured (needs: pharmacy director and P&T committee approval).

Not recommended: No immediate allocation changes or clinical substitutions; those are clinical decisions for the treating clinicians and the committee.
